faq.question: Is the domain name included?
faq.answer: The purchase and renewal of your domain name are defined in your quote. Chambre 17 can help you with every step. The domain remains registered in your name.

faq.question: Is monthly management mandatory?
faq.answer: No. Website creation and monthly management are separate services. If you do not choose a subscription, hosting and maintenance arrangements will be agreed before delivery.

faq.question: Can I request changes after the website is built?
faq.answer: Yes. Simple changes are included according to your management plan. Additional requests and new features are quoted separately.

faq.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
faq.answer: Yes. Subscriptions have no minimum commitment period and can be cancelled with 30 days’ notice. Website handover or transfer arrangements are specified in the agreed terms.

faq.question: How long does it take to create my website?
faq.answer: The timeline depends on the project’s complexity and the content available. We will provide an estimated schedule with your quote.

faq.question: Will my website work on phones?
faq.answer: Yes. All websites created by Chambre 17 are designed to work on computers, tablets and smartphones.
